Let's do find with path=".", name=None. Then we can filter out entries that contain "/"? Actually find returns names relative to current dir, so if there are subdirectories, they will include slash. We want only those without slash. Also we want hidden ones too. So we can call find with path=".", name=None. Then filter. Let's do that.
